references.text: The same list of peoples to be destroyed, and the same command regarding the ban (herem) against these nations in the promised land.
Mentions the same nations that God promised to destroy before Israel.
God promises to drive out the same nations from the land of Canaan.
Mentions the same peoples who are to be driven out of the land.
Joshua mentions the same six nations that Israel was to drive out.
The list of peoples who gathered against Israel includes the same nations.
Mentions the same Canaanite nations in connection with the conquest of the land.
Joshua summarizes how God gave the same nations into Israel's hand.
Explains the ban and that the names of the kings are to be blotted out under heaven.
The practical execution of the ban (herem) at Jericho.
